title: Lung Epithelial Cell Prep
protocol: Keep all solutions on ice.
Anesthetize animal and clean with 70% Ethanol.
Exsanguinate and remove ventral ribcage.
Perfuse left then right ventricle with cold sterile PBS until the lungs turn white.
Expose trachea and nick with scissors.
Insert 20G catheter and lavage the lungs with 1 ml cold PBS.
Repeat lung lavage three times.
Inject 1 ml of dispase down trachea.
Wait 30 seconds then infuse the lungs with 0.2 ml warm 1% low melt agarose.
Tie off the trachea using string, remove catheter and pour ice cold PBS over lung.
Remove the lung carefully without nicking the tissue and place into petri dish containing PBS on ice to allow agarose to harden.
Cut each lobe from the mainstem bronchi.
Cut the proximal-most ¼ of each lobe surrounding the bronchi to minimize inclusion of basal cells in cell preparation.
Put the cut lobes into a 50 ml tube containing dispase and rock at room temperature for 45 minutes.
Add 10 ml of sort buffer and 50 U/ml DNAse to the lung tissue.
Pipette up and down until the lung tissue is dissociated.
Incubate for 10 minutes rocking at 37 degrees Celsius.
Transfer the contents through a 100 µm strainer into a 50 ml tube.
Transfer filtered suspension to a 15 ml tube.
Spin the cells for 5 minutes at 550 g at 4 degrees Celsius.
Suck away as much of the agarose as possible without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cells in 10 ml of sort buffer and let recover shaking for at least one hour at 37 degrees Celsius.
Centrifuge cells at 550 g at 4 degrees Celsius for 8 minutes.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml of sort buffer and count.
Adjust volume to 10^7 cells/ml.
Stain cells using chosen combination of antibodies and isotype controls for at least 30 minutes at 4 degrees Celsius.
Wash cells two times with cold PBS.
